reasons.android.permission.CAMERA: Reads the code on the screen of the device you are adding. Nothing is recorded or kept.
reasons.android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS: Tells you when something needs you. Vyre makes each notice itself; nothing is sent through a push service.
reasons.android.permission.ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE: Knows whether the phone is online, so Vyre can say so and reconnect to your box.
reasons.android.permission.USE_BIOMETRIC: Asks for your fingerprint or face before the phone signs an approval or opens the vault.
reasons.android.permission.INTERNET: Talks to your own box. Nothing else.
reasons.android.permission.VIBRATE: A short tap when you press a control, if the phone's settings allow it.
reasons.{package}.DYNAMIC_RECEIVER_NOT_EXPORTED_: Added by the system library so only Vyre can receive its own broadcasts.
reasons.android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE: Keeps the app's own connection to your home while the app is closed, so it can tell you when something needs you. The system shows an ongoing 'Vyre is connected' notice while it does, and you can turn it off.
reasons.android.permission.FOREGROUND_SERVICE_DA: The kind of foreground service that keeps that connection: it syncs with your own home and nothing else.
